meta.title: How Does a $600 Pair of Levi’s Fit? (501 LVC’s STF)
meta.description:
Get your Levi's 501s here! https://fave.co/3DFMF9A

Ah, Levi 501's. The most famous jeans on the planet Earth. What about these special completely made in Japan ones though? 

Ever heard of Instagram? Well me too, let us party. @8thWeekday @TheIronSnail

So as I was saying. Levi's is the big player in the denim world (of course). Their raw denim/LVC line isn't as big as many other brands but they still have some big players...and then they have this big player. These are Levi's 501 Day jeans which celebrate the birth of the 501. How does Levi's celebrate? The pull a fit from their LVC line and have it completely made in Japan. They also put the Levi's patch, buttons, and rivets in Japanese. 

NEATO!
